nodes.description: msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for authorization, allowances and balance ownership
block.timestamp: miner-influenceable time source used for epoch derivation and Uniswap cumulative pricing
ERC20 _balances mapping(address => uint256) holding token balances
ERC20 _allowances nested mapping holding spender approvals
ERC20 _totalSupply tracking minted ETHC supply
EIP712_DOMAIN_SEPARATOR used to bind permit signatures to this contract and chain
Permittable nonces mapping(address => uint256) consumed by permit for replay protection
Roles.Role _minters mapping storing addresses holding the Minter role
Oracle _dao address authorized to call setup/capture
Oracle _ethic address of the ETHC token used to build the pair
Oracle _pair Uniswap V2 pair used as the price source
Oracle _timestamp storing the last observed cumulative block timestamp
Oracle _cumulative storing the last observed cumulative price
Oracle _reserve storing the counter-asset reserve used to validate the reading
Storage.State _state of the upgradeable ETHCS proxy (provider addresses, balances, accounts, epochs, candidates)
PoolStorage.State _state holding pool balances, provider addresses, paused flag and per-account states
Permittable.permit: verifies an EIP712 signature with ecrecover and grants an allowance
Ethic.transferFrom: moves tokens and decrements allowance unless unlimited
Ethic.mint: onlyMinter-gated supply increase
ERC20._transfer internal: updates both balances and emits Transfer
ERC20._approve internal: writes the allowance mapping and emits Approval
ERC20._mint internal: increases total supply and recipient balance
ERC20._burn internal: decreases balance and total supply
MinterRole.addMinter: onlyMinter-gated role grant
MinterRole.onlyMinter modifier checking isMinter(_msgSender())
Oracle.setup: onlyDao pair creation and index resolution
Oracle.capture: onlyDao entry point returning a price snapshot and validity flag
Oracle.updatePrice: computes the time-weighted price from cumulative values and timeElapsed
Oracle.updateReserve: refreshes the counter reserve from the pair
UniswapV2OracleLibrary.currentCumulativePrices: reads pair cumulative prices and mocks elapsed accumulation
UniswapV2OracleLibrary.currentBlockTimestamp: truncates block.timestamp into uint32
Pool.deposit: pulls UNI-V2 via transferFrom then credits staged balance
Pool.withdraw: sends UNI-V2 out and debits staged balance
Pool.claim: sends ETHC out and debits claimable balance
Pool.bond: converts staged balance to bonded plus phantom rewards
Pool.unbond: converts bonded balance to staged and claimable
Pool.provide: burns rewarded balance into Uniswap liquidity and bonds the LP tokens
Pool.emergencyWithdraw: onlyDao arbitrary token drain to the dao
Pool.emergencyPause: onlyDao flag that freezes state-changing pool entry points
Pool.balanceCheck: invariant asserting UNI-V2 balance covers staged plus bonded
Liquidity.addLiquidity: transfers ETHC and DAI into the pair and mints LP tokens
Upgradeable.upgradeTo: sets a new implementation and delegatecalls initialize()
Upgradeable.setImplementation: validates contract code and writes the EIP1967 slot
Deployer1.initialize: deploys the Ethic token into _state.provider.ethic
Deployer2.initialize: deploys and sets up the Oracle into _state.provider.oracle
Deployer3.initialize: deploys the Pool into _state.provider.pool
Deployer.implement: external unguarded entry point calling upgradeTo
Getters.blockTimestamp: overridable view returning block.timestamp
Getters.epochTime: derives the current epoch from block.timestamp and the epoch strategy
Permission.initializer modifier marking the implementation as initialized
Require.that: reverts with a formatted message when a condition fails
ecrecover call in permit returning a signature-recovered address
delegatecall to newImplementation during upgradeTo
Inline assembly sstore writing the implementation address to a fixed slot
extcodesize based isContract check used for upgrade validation
univ2().transferFrom external token call inside Pool.deposit
univ2().transfer external token call inside Pool.withdraw
ethic().transfer external token call inside Pool.claim
IERC20(token).transfer of an arbitrary token to the dao in emergencyWithdraw
External calls to price0/1CumulativeLast and getReserves on the Uniswap pair
External ETHC transfer, DAI transferFrom and pair mint inside addLiquidity
SafeMath.sub guarded subtraction used for balance and supply debits
Timestamp arithmetic (sub/div/add) converting block.timestamp into an epoch number
owner parameter of permit, the intended signer
spender parameter of permit, the approval beneficiary
value parameter of permit, the approved amount
deadline parameter of permit, the signature expiry
account parameter of Ethic.mint
amount parameter of Ethic.mint
recipient parameter flowing into _transfer
value parameter of Pool.deposit, the staged UNI-V2 amount
recovered address returned by ecrecover inside permit
digest hash built from the domain separator and permit struct inside permit
newPhantom computed inside Pool.bond from reward math
newClaimable computed inside Pool.unbond from the bonded ratio
daiAmount computed by UniswapV2Library.quote inside addLiquidity
newImplementation parameter of implement/upgradeTo
timeElapsed computed inside Oracle.updatePrice as the division denominator

normalization_plan.reason: owner is consumed only by the permit signature verification flow
spender is consumed only by the permit allowance flow
value is consumed only by the permit allowance flow
deadline is consumed only by the permit expiry check
account is forwarded directly to the internal _mint balance update
amount is forwarded directly to the internal _mint supply update
recipient is used only inside the internal transfer routine
value is the single input of the deposit state update
recovered exists only to validate the permit signature result
digest is the exact bytes32 fed into the ecrecover operation
newPhantom is computed and immediately credited within bond
newClaimable is computed and immediately credited within unbond
daiAmount is produced by the quote and used to pull DAI in addLiquidity
the implementation address is consumed by upgradeTo
timeElapsed is used as the divisor inside updatePrice
